resources.string: Location permission (including background access) is required. Tap below, then choose Permissions → Location → Allow all the time.\n\nThis app never stores or collects your location — and with no internet permission, it couldn\'t send it anywhere even if it tried.
This app is an independent utility and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or a product of Google LLC.\n\nWhy? I built it for my own use, and others might find it useful.

Timeline Tracks needs permission to show a notification while it\'s running. Without it, there\'s no way to see that tracking is active or to stop it — you might forget it\'s on.\n\nTap Go to Settings, then enable Notifications for Timeline Tracks.
A shorter interval gives Timeline higher-quality tracks; a longer interval saves battery. The default, just under 2 minutes, is a good compromise.
If 5 consecutive locations are all within 100 meters of each other, the app assumes you\'re stationary and stops automatically.

Start Timeline Tracks when you start a hike, boat ride, or other activities far from Wi-Fi access points.

Timeline Tracks runs in the background, requesting GPS locations. Google Timeline (in the Google Maps app), and any other app on your phone, receives the locations for free.

Timeline Tracks is 100% privacy-safe: it never stores your locations, runs entirely on your phone, and has no internet permission, so it can't send your location data anywhere.

For best results, make sure battery optimization is set to 'Unrestricted' for this app in Android Settings.
